SELECT 
    player.last_seen_user_name,
    COUNT(server_ban.banning_admin) AS ban_count
FROM 
    player
LEFT JOIN 
    server_ban
ON 
    player.user_id = server_ban.banning_admin
WHERE 
  $__timeFilter(ban_time)
GROUP BY 
    player.user_id, 
    player.last_seen_user_name
ORDER BY 
    ban_count DESC;

SELECT
    server_ban.reason,
    player1.last_seen_user_name AS player_user_name,
    player2.last_seen_user_name AS banning_admin_name
FROM
    server_ban
JOIN
    player AS player1 ON server_ban.player_user_id = player1.user_id
JOIN
    player AS player2 ON server_ban.banning_admin = player2.user_id
WHERE 
    $__timeFilter(server_ban.ban_time)
ORDER BY 
    server_ban.ban_time DESC;

SELECT 
    DATE(ban_time) AS ban_date, 
    COUNT(*) AS ban_count
FROM 
    server_ban
WHERE 
    reason LIKE '%raid%'
GROUP BY 
    ban_date
ORDER BY
ban_date
DESC LIMIT 50

SELECT
  -- Group by hour using the message's timestamp
  date_trunc('hour', date) AS time,
  COUNT(*) AS message_count
FROM admin_log
WHERE
  ($__timeFilter(date) AND
  (message LIKE 'Whisper from%' OR message LIKE 'Say from%'))
GROUP BY time
ORDER BY time;

SELECT
  date_trunc('hour', date) AS time,
  SUM(
    CASE 
      WHEN POSITION('transformed: ' IN message) > 0 THEN 
        LENGTH(SUBSTRING(message FROM POSITION('transformed: ' IN message) + 13))
      ELSE 
        LENGTH(SUBSTRING(message FROM POSITION(': ' IN message) + 2))
    END
  ) AS character_count
FROM admin_log
WHERE
  $__timeFilter(date) AND
  (message LIKE 'Whisper from%' OR message LIKE 'Say from%')
GROUP BY time
ORDER BY time;

SELECT
  date_trunc('hour', date) AS time,
  AVG(
    CASE 
      WHEN POSITION('transformed: ' IN message) > 0 THEN 
        LENGTH(SUBSTRING(message FROM POSITION('transformed: ' IN message) + 13))
      ELSE 
        LENGTH(SUBSTRING(message FROM POSITION(': ' IN message) + 2))
    END
  ) AS avg_characters_per_message
FROM admin_log
WHERE
  $__timeFilter(date) AND
  (message LIKE 'Whisper from%' OR message LIKE 'Say from%')
GROUP BY time
ORDER BY time;

WITH player_playtime AS (
    SELECT
        play_time.player_id
    FROM
        play_time
    WHERE
        play_time.tracker = 'Overall'
        AND play_time.time_spent > '10:00:00'
)
SELECT
    COUNT(*) AS "Amount",
    profile.species AS "Species"
FROM
    profile
JOIN
    preference ON profile.preference_id = preference.preference_id
JOIN
    player_playtime ON preference.user_id = player_playtime.player_id
JOIN
    player ON preference.user_id = player.user_id
WHERE
    $__timeFilter(player.last_seen_time)
GROUP BY
    profile.species
ORDER BY
    "Amount" DESC;

SELECT
    CASE
        WHEN profile.age < 20 THEN 'Under 20'
        WHEN profile.age >= 20 AND profile.age < 30 THEN '20-29'
        WHEN profile.age >= 30 AND profile.age < 40 THEN '30-39'
        WHEN profile.age >= 40 AND profile.age < 60 THEN '40-59'
        ELSE '60+'
    END AS "Age Group",
    COUNT(*) AS "Amount"
FROM
    profile
JOIN
    preference ON profile.preference_id = preference.preference_id
JOIN
    player_playtime ON preference.user_id = player_playtime.player_id
JOIN
    player ON preference.user_id = player.user_id
WHERE
    $__timeFilter(player.last_seen_time)
GROUP BY
    "Age Group"
ORDER BY
    "Amount" DESC;

SELECT
    COUNT(*) AS "Count",
    trait.trait_name AS "Trait"
FROM
    trait
JOIN
    profile ON trait.profile_id = profile.profile_id
JOIN
    preference ON profile.preference_id = preference.preference_id
JOIN
    player_playtime ON preference.user_id = player_playtime.player_id
JOIN
    player ON preference.user_id = player.user_id
WHERE
    $__timeFilter(player.last_seen_time)
GROUP BY
    trait.trait_name
ORDER BY
    "Count" DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT
  p.last_seen_user_name,
  pt.time_spent
FROM
  play_time AS pt
INNER JOIN
  player AS p ON pt.player_id = p.user_id
WHERE
  pt.tracker = 'Overall'
  AND p.user_id NOT IN (SELECT user_id FROM admin)
  AND p.last_seen_user_name NOT IN ('ARandomHunter', 'Wyatt_', 'beanman11121', 'FourHead', 'Gruinspace', 'EmmaFaith', 'realDonaldTrump', 'Nravelk', 'Drifin', 'send_fbi', 'deathsquad_enjoyer')
ORDER BY
  pt.time_spent DESC
LIMIT 50;

SELECT
  p.last_seen_user_name,
  pt.time_spent
FROM
  play_time AS pt
INNER JOIN
  player AS p ON pt.player_id = p.user_id
WHERE
  pt.tracker = 'JobPassenger'
  AND p.user_id NOT IN (SELECT user_id FROM admin)
  AND p.last_seen_user_name NOT IN ('ThePuro', 'ARandomHunter', 'Wyatt_', 'beanman11121', 'FourHead', 'Gruinspace', 'EmmaFaith', 'realDonaldTrump', 'Nravelk', 'Drifin', 'send_fbi', 'deathsquad_enjoyer')
ORDER BY
  pt.time_spent DESC
LIMIT 5000;
